back: A book, database or website consulted for particular information rather than read from cover to cover.
Dictionary: meaning, spelling, pronunciation, part of speech. Thesaurus: synonyms and antonyms.
Encyclopaedia: topic overviews. Atlas: maps. Catalogue: books the library holds and where.
The words at the top of a dictionary page showing its first and last entries.
Contents: front, chapters in book order. Index: back, alphabetical topics with page numbers.
Glossary: meanings of specialised words. Appendix: extra material such as tables, data or documents.
Preface: why the book was written and how to use it. Imprint page: publication date, edition, ISBN.
Who wrote it? Why? When? Can it be checked? How is it presented?
Presenting someone else's words or ideas as your own without acknowledgement.
notes: Use quotation marks and name your sources.
